info.title: CompI API
info.description: API for the CompI web and mobile apps. Authenticate with a Supabase Auth access token.

bearer.description: Supabase Auth access token of the signed-in employee.

codeSent.description: Whether a two-step code was emailed (next = second_factor).

expiresAt.description: Unix time (s) when the access token expires.

needsMfa.description: Rank-1 accounts must verify a second factor before using the workspace.

mustChangePassword.description: Signed in with a temporary password; it must be changed first.

nextCursor.description: Pass as `cursor` to get the next page; null on the last page.

serviceNotes.description: Notes for front of house (sala), Spanish.

entries.description: Up to 41 entries: 40 per page plus one to tell whether a next page exists.

items.description: Hours balance in minutes: `total` up to this month, `adjustment` set for this month.

CreatedAccount.description: The temporary password is returned once and never stored.

ingredientes.description: Ingredients of the recipe sheet, to start from.

post.summary: Sign in with email and password
post.description: Returns the session tokens and the next step. When two-step verification is required, a code is emailed.

post.summary: Exchange a refresh token for new tokens

409.description: This session does not need verification.

429.description: Wait before asking for another code.

200.description: Result. `invalid`: wrong code; `expired`: ask for a new one; `locked`: too many wrong codes, ask for a new one.

post.description: For accounts created with a temporary password. Returns fresh tokens without the pending-change mark.

422.description: Choose another password (10+ characters, different from the temporary one).

post.summary: Set a new password with a personal recovery code

204.description: Password changed; other sessions were ended.

403.description: Email or code not valid.

post.summary: Register an employee and create their account
post.description: CompI allocates a personal @compichef.com address (initial, surname, hotel code) and creates the login with a temporary password that must be changed at first sign-in. `requestId` makes retries safe: the same request returns the same address, and a second account is never created (409 `already_created`).
